method.method_draft: Use the image to identify the three gases and the text to establish that each sample has 10.0 g, the same container volume, and the same temperature. If tempted to compare molar masses, instead apply the ideal-gas bridge: d = PM/RT, but P is not necessarily the same for the three gases because the mole amounts differ. Substitute P = nRT/V and n = m/M; the molar mass cancels, leaving d = m/V. Since m and V are the same for SO2, CH4, and NCl3, all three densities are equal.

推理：要求比较密度。虽然 SO2、CH4、NCl3 的摩尔质量不同，但不能只用摩尔质量判断密度，因为三个容器中气体的物质的量不同，压力也不一定相同。理想气体密度公式可写为 d = PM/RT；又由 PV = nRT 得 P = nRT/V，并且 n = m/M。代入得到 d = (nRT/V)M/RT = nM/V = m/V。也就是说，在这里密度只等于每个样品的质量除以容器体积。三种气体的质量都为 10.0 g，容器体积也相同，所以三者密度相同，没有某一种更大。
